environment.description: Same ECS Fargate task in an isolated account (222233334444) governed by an AWS Organization SCP (policy ID: p-a1b2c3d4e5) attached at the OU level. The SCP contains a Deny statement with StringNotEquals condition on 'rds-db:db-user' restricting connections to role 'migrator_readonly'. Additionally, the IAM execution role (arn:aws:iam::222233334444:role/MigrationTaskRole-Prod) has a permission boundary (arn:aws:iam::222233334444:policy/PB-DatabaseMigrations) that explicitly denies 'rds-db:connect' unless the resource ARN matches 'arn:aws:rds-db:*:*:dbuser:*/migrator_readonly'. The 'migrator_readonly' PostgreSQL role has GRANT SELECT on all tables and GRANT CREATE on schema 'public' but explicitly REVOKE'd COMMENT, EXECUTE on functions, and all DDL except CREATE TABLE. The pg_hba.conf on the RDS parameter group enforces that the 'migrator_readonly' role can only execute statements matching a pg_stat_statements allowlist via the pgaudit.log_catalog extension with a custom event trigger that raises an exception on any COMMENT statement.

config.db_user_privileges: SELECT, CREATE TABLE only (COMMENT explicitly revoked)
config.network: Private subnet, no NAT gateway, VPC endpoint to RDS only
config.pg_event_trigger: RAISE EXCEPTION on COMMENT commands via event trigger on ddl_command_start
